title: Audit: native stage 3 lands in stage 2's stopped range
body:
## Summary
- For the selected native receipt, `s*L3 - L2 > 1015784602045963452130`. A width `w >= e^s` at `e >= 2^L3` therefore sits above stage 2's cutoff.
- The same `s` reproduces the published stage-2 integer `floor(s*L2 - L1) = 2851485324488315`. Replacing `L3` by `L2` makes the difference negative.
- The stock coefficient stays null. An external factor of 1 and a hoisted routing factor are not separated. `ceil(log2(8*8194)) = 17` is only a comparison with the recorded stage-3 headroom.

No new kappa and no selected-frontier change. Seed `7eb97eef6bda950f3a69b03c7259617f`, scope key `eee4a5467dd91c47ef45`, base `8c8bcecb03def61bca701dd3b045932d39c48022`. Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2929

The native stage-2 handoff is https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18949652. Overlap on 2026-10-16 covered 469 open PRs and 1609 discussions. This is the next cutoff pair named there, not another first-stage BIT coefficient.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3 -B research/stage3-stock-margin/verify.py` prints `PASS_STAGE3_STOCK_MARGIN stage=3 margin=1015784602045963452130 routing_room=1701909188404384116 coefficient=unresolved stage2_margin_reproduced=true`
- [x] `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/stage3-stock-margin --check-only`
- [x] Python 3.12 registered replay: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/stage3-stock-margin outcome=negative-result`
- [ ] Selected baseline was not rerun: this sparse checkout does not contain the assembly roots that check needs. Selected kappa is unchanged. The selected-record sha256 on this main is `bb2eaa58647b353f88d0aec2eafb9d30df1be53589231b23e12ceef3e4bad129`.

## Limits
The margin does not choose a coefficient. The complex `m=73` supplier and stages 4–7 are untouched. Predecessor credit for the stage-2 split stays with that handoff.

Prepared by Riquelme Soares (@hevlyo) with substantial AI assistance. Apache-2.0.
